prompt: Let $g(x) = 10 - 2x$. What is $g(3)$? Give just the number.
hint: The letter $g$ is only the name of this rule. It works the same way as a rule named $f$.

hints.text: The letter $g$ is only the name of this rule. It works the same way as a rule named $f$.
Replace $x$ with $3$ to get $10 - 2 \times 3$. Do the multiplication before the subtraction.
$2 \times 3 = 6$ and $10 - 6 = 4$, so the value of $g(3)$ is $4$.

explanation: $g(3)$ means the input is $3$, so replace $x$ with $3$: $g(3) = 10 - 2 \times 3$.
Multiplication comes before subtraction, so work out $2 \times 3 = 6$ first.
Then subtract from $10$: $10 - 6 = 4$, so the answer is $g(3) = 4$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Countdown machine
steps: The machine starts at $10$ and takes away $2$ for every $1$ of input.
